✅ All 11 data model files have been created at `lib/data/models/`:

| # | File | Size | Key Features |
|---|------|------|-------------|
| 1 | `user_model.dart` | 2,890 B | Default currency `₹`, `List<String> focusAreas` |
| 2 | `tag_model.dart` | 1,615 B | Hex color string, nullable emoji |
| 3 | `task_model.dart` | 3,271 B | Priority 0-3, default emoji `📝`, 4 nullable fields |
| 4 | `habit_model.dart` | 3,063 B | `List<String> completions` (date strings), frequency enum |
| 5 | `mood_entry_model.dart` | 1,716 B | Mood string values, nullable note |
| 6 | `transaction_model.dart` | 2,633 B | `(num).toDouble()` for safe amount deserialization |
| 7 | `financial_goal_model.dart` | 2,909 B | Computed `progress` and `isCompleted` getters |
| 8 | `debt_payment_model.dart` | 1,822 B | paid/missed/snoozed status, nullable paidAt |
| 9 | `debt_model.dart` | 4,035 B | Imports `DebtPaymentModel`, nested list serialization, `totalPaid`/`totalRemaining` getters |
| 10 | `quote_model.dart` | 956 B | Simple text + author |
| 11 | `memory_model.dart` | 4,115 B | Computed `taskCompletionRate`, `habitCompletionRate`, `netMoney` getters |

**Every model includes:**
- ✅ Immutable `final` fields with `const` constructor
- ✅ Named parameters (required + optional with defaults)
- ✅ `fromJson()` factory with safe null handling and `(num).toDouble()` for doubles
- ✅ `toJson()` method (DateTime → ISO 8601 strings)
- ✅ `copyWith()` using `Function()?` pattern for nullable fields (so you can explicitly set them to null)
- ✅ `==` operator and `hashCode` overrides (with list equality helpers where needed)
- ✅ `toString()` override
- ✅ Proper null safety throughout
- ✅ `debt_model.dart` imports via `package:jarvis/data/models/debt_payment_model.dart`
